judgement.reason: Vaultwarden supports PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL, and attachments can go to S3 as a contained change, so deployable with changes is reasonable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The /data volume holds attachments, sends, RSA keys and the admin config.json besides the database, and the shown lines do not prove that a setting moves all of that to PostgreSQL or S3 in this build, so the finding stands.
